cancel_crm_operation: Cancel an operation before publication and keep the previous complete CRM state. Completed operations cannot be cancelled. Cancellation is authorized on the backend and is not a rollback of already published data.
configure_record_model: Preview or apply a typed configuration bundle containing types, fields, relationships, calculations and access presets. Preserve the same expectedRevision, idempotencyKey and operations between preview and apply. Temporary $client references connect new definitions atomically. Calculations use a bounded node program, never executable code. Schema management is separate from record access; role grants and published summaries require their own authority. Use delete to move a list, field or relationship to Trash; restore it or delete it permanently with manage_trash. For field deletion, preview.deletion.cleaned and the apply result's deletionCleaned name the views, layouts and widgets changed automatically; references lists newly resolved IDs, not consumers. A pending operation status gives retryAfterMs as the minimum wait before polling again.
connect_messaging_account: Generate a link the user opens in a browser to connect a channel: Gmail (google), Outlook, IMAP email, WhatsApp, LinkedIn Classic, Sales Navigator or Recruiter, Instagram, or Telegram. You return the link; the user finishes auth there. The link is for the requesting user only and expires in 30 minutes. Needs Create on Inbox messages, a plan with messaging, and a free connected-account slot on that plan.
discard_message_draft: Delete the exact saved draft revision using its message id and opaque revision token.
discover_record_types: Find accessible record types by name or stable type IDs. Results include schemaRevision, permitted actions and whether you may edit the data model. Use page and pageSize to continue; includeEmbedded reveals types such as line items.
export_crm_records: Export one list as the JSON document of the list page's Export as JSON: every readable record matching the search, filters and sort, with sub-list rows, assignments, channel identities and links, up to 5,000 records. Formatted text arrives between untrusted-content markers. Excel export stays a REST download.
fetch: Read a result from `search` by its unchanged id: `wiki:<uuid>` or the exact returned Knowledge Base URL, `file:<uuid>`, `record:<typeId>:<recordId>`, or `doc:<locale>:<slug>`. Knowledge Base Markdown and file text arrive in bounded chunks: pass a search result's `offset` to open at the matched section, and continue with `nextOffset` until it is null. At offset 0 a page or file longer than one chunk also returns an `outline` of its H1 to H3 headings with offsets. Internal Knowledge Base links are absolute and directly followable. File text arrives between untrusted-content markers and needs read access to the record and field that hold the file. Knowledge Base Read is required for Knowledge Base content, and record reads recheck current permissions. Links into the app are full URLs on this instance (its configured `BASE_URL`) and open the reader's own workspace.
get_activities: Activity timeline for accessible record references (`typeId` and `recordId`) or types, including directly linked records where a relationship shows them. Combine typed inclusion, exclusion and presence filters for records, source kinds, providers, accounts and conversations; also filter by time range. Tenant, record, and inbox permissions apply to every record and source. The result contains `items`, `availableSources`, and an opaque-position `nextCursor`; pass that cursor unchanged to load older entries. The default limit is 25, maximum 100. Legacy entity scopes, page numbers, and entity-specific filters are rejected.
get_calendars: Three modes: list: "calendars" (default) lists the calendars of accessible connected accounts; list: "events" lists calendar events ordered by start time, filterable by calendarId or a startsAt date range; with eventId it returns one event's detail including organizer and attendees. Ids match the entityId of calendar webhook events.
get_docs_page: One documentation page as markdown with its canonical URL. Links into the app are full URLs on this instance (its configured `BASE_URL`) and open the reader's own workspace. Pass a nonempty `anchor` returned by search with the original question as `query` to read that selected section in about 1,400 characters. With `query` alone, searches for the best-matching section (plus a second section when it fits). Omit both for the full page. Lists valid slugs on a miss.
get_messaging_threads: Without threadId, filter and paginate accessible inbox threads; with threadId, read one thread and a page of messages. Participant record references carry typeId, recordId, title, avatarUrl and canEdit after current record-access checks. New participantContactId filter values are typeId:recordId; legacy contact UUID filters remain decodable. Message and account permissions apply independently.
get_record_model: Read fields, stable select-option IDs, relationships, capabilities and configuration revision for the relevant typeIds. Labels and descriptions are customer data. Schema visibility does not grant record access.
get_social_post_engagement: Engagement on a post: kind=comments (default) lists comments, kind=reactions lists who reacted; with commentId it returns the reactions on that comment.
get_social_posts: Posts on LinkedIn or Instagram, read through a connected account. Use `authorIdentifier=me` for the account owner. For another person, use `get_social_profile.id`, `get_social_posts.items[].author.id` (list mode), `get_social_posts.author.id` (single-post mode), `get_social_post_engagement.items[].author.id` (comments), `get_social_post_engagement.items[].sender.id` (reactions), or `manage_social_relations.items[].user.id`. Resolve `get_messaging_threads.items[].participants[].identifier` (list mode) or `get_messaging_threads.thread.participants[].identifier` (detail mode) through `get_social_profile` first; do not pass a thread participant identifier directly. Pass `get_social_posts.items[].id` as `postId` to fetch one post. On continuation, repeat the same account, author, and limit with next_cursor.
get_social_profile: A person or company profile. For a person, use `profileType=person` with `me`, `get_messaging_threads.items[].participants[].identifier`, `get_messaging_threads.thread.participants[].identifier`, `get_social_posts.items[].author.id`, `get_social_posts.author.id`, `get_social_post_engagement.items[].author.id`, `get_social_post_engagement.items[].sender.id`, `manage_social_relations.items[].user.id`, a LinkedIn Classic public profile slug, or an Instagram username. For a LinkedIn company, use `profileType=company` with `linkedin_search_sales_companies.items[].id`, `linkedin_search_sales_leads.items[].current_positions[].company_id`, `linkedin_manage_sales_lists.items[].current_positions[].company_id`, or `get_social_profile.current_positions[].company_id`. Reuse `get_social_profile.id` with the same `profileType`.
get_workspace_context: Read the current user, company, role catalog with permissions, accessible connected messaging accounts, and the Knowledge Base's Operating Guide, its procedure index with when-to-use triggers, and a permission-filtered list of knowledge pages (pass `wikiPage` for more; omitted without Knowledge Base Read) in one call. The natural first call of a session. Discover record-type labels separately with discover_record_types and fetch the relevant configuration with get_record_model.
import_crm_records: Create or update up to 100 records and 500 links of one list from an export document in one atomic call (mode create or update), checked against the current schema revision. An invalid row rejects the whole document. Needs create or edit access on the list.
linkedin_get_sales_search_parameters: Resolves the ids behind LinkedIn Sales Navigator search inputs by type (locations, industries, job titles, functions, companies, schools, groups and more) plus your lead/account lists and saved/recent searches; keyword is optional, so a bare type enumerates the whole family.
linkedin_manage_sales_lists: LinkedIn Sales Navigator lead and account lists: list them, browse the members of one, or save a lead using `linkedin_search_sales_leads.items[].id` or `get_social_profile.id`, or a company using `linkedin_search_sales_companies.items[].id` or an `items[].current_positions[].company_id` path documented above. New lists are created in Sales Navigator itself.
linkedin_search_sales_companies: Finds companies via LinkedIn Sales Navigator: either from a pasted company search URL or as a structured search with filters (keywords, location, industry, headcount, annual revenue and more). Pass `linkedin_search_sales_companies.items[].id` to `get_social_profile` with `profileType=company`. Requires a Sales Navigator subscription.
linkedin_search_sales_leads: Finds people via LinkedIn Sales Navigator: either from a pasted search URL or as a structured search with filters (keywords, location, industry, company, job title, seniority and more). Resolve `linkedin_search_sales_leads.items[].current_positions[].company_id` with `get_social_profile` and `profileType=company`. Requires a Sales Navigator subscription.
list_users: Team members with id, name, email, roleId, and status. When the caller's role has Users & Roles read access Assigned, only the caller is returned.
lookup_address: Look up postal addresses for free text, such as a street with house number and city, through the server's address service. Each candidate carries a candidateToken: writing `{kind: "address", candidateToken}` with mutate_crm_record within 24 hours stores that address as verified, while address parts written directly stay unverified. available false means address lookup is off on this server. Place names arrive between untrusted-content markers.
manage_connected_accounts: List your connected accounts with folders and email settings, and change one you own: choose the synced email folders, set the signature and email appearance, share it with the workspace or make it private, resync it, or disconnect it. Disconnecting cannot be undone. Needs Edit on Inbox messages, Delete to disconnect.
manage_conversation_records: Read, link or unlink records for one accessible inbox conversation. These links affect only that thread, never other conversations or the sender’s global channel associations. Link and unlink need expectedRevision, idempotencyKey, Inbox management and permission to update the record.
manage_data_views: Discover, inspect, create, update, select, reset and delete personal saved views. Discover the surfaceKey first; generic record surfaces use stable type IDs. Updates patch only supplied settings; a grouping can carry up to 8 summaries (sum, average, min or max of a number or currency field). Reset removes your overrides so the list shows every field in its configured order as an ungrouped table, without changing records. Deleting a view requires its exact current name and ID; a mismatch returns a specific error, while an unknown ID returns not found. Deletion moves it to Trash (a dashboard view takes its widgets along), never its records. Configuration and view lists are paginated and searchable.
manage_record_detail_layout: Read, save or reset your personal record-detail layout with stable type and field IDs. Read returns accessible field choices, pins, hidden fields, field order and the configuration revision. Save requires the complete layout, expectedRevision and an idempotencyKey. Reset removes your layout: every field shows in its configured order and none is pinned. It does not change records or other users’ preferences.
manage_record_files: Upload files into a file field and read them. upload takes base64 content of up to 3 MB and, with recordId, writes the file into that record's field at once, appending it or replacing the files there; create_upload returns a PUT URL and headers for exactly size bytes that work for 15 minutes, after which you write the fileId into the field with mutate_crm_record. read returns the file's details, a download link valid for 15 minutes and, once extracted, its text in chunks with offset and nextOffset. Uploads count against the workspace storage.
manage_roles: Read, create or edit roles with system permissions and access to any configured record type. System permissions (resource plus actions) and record grants (typeId plus actions) share the actions create, update, delete, readAll and readOwn; each listed entry replaces its actions, omitted ones keep theirs and an empty list removes access. Read the editor context first, preserve unrelated grants, and supply a revision and retry key when saving or deleting. Deletion is blocked for assigned roles and roles used by access presets.
manage_routines: One tool with an `action` switch: list, runs, create, update, pause, run_now, delete. A routine is saved instructions the assistant runs on a cron schedule or when a CRM event fires. Omitting `enabled` on create produces a LIVE routine, so pass `enabled: false` to draft one; the hosted assistant must state `enabled` explicitly and drafts unless the user asked to activate. A change of `triggerKind` must arrive with that kind's schedule or events. pause disables the routine and settles its queued runs to skipped, which re-enabling does not undo; only an active system administrator may pause or delete a routine. run_now applies to scheduled routines only, and only to an enabled routine the caller owns. It refuses paused AI work, inactive owners and exhausted credits before queuing. A Customermates platform pause returns `platformPaused`; workspace admins cannot lift it. A routine paused by a workspace administrator uses `adminPaused`; manual test runs still use `triggerKind: schedule`. Runs are paginated by `cursor` and carry status, summary, trigger and the `error` block reason. delete moves the routine to Trash, where it stops running until manage_trash restores it. list returns compact name, owner, trigger and enabled summaries by default. Pass includePrompts: true for full configurations including prompts, or owner: "mine" for routines you own.
manage_social_relations: Connection requests: list invitations (received by default, or your own sent/outgoing via direction), invite with `get_social_profile.id` (sends a real request), accept, or cancel by invitationId.
manage_team: Invite members by email (action invite, up to 20, sends real invitation emails), return the invitation link (invite_link), or change a member's role and status (update_member). For update_member, identify the member by userId or email; if you provide both, they must match. invite and invite_link need Create on Users & Roles; update_member needs Edit, like REST.
manage_trash: Restore Trash items (or every item of one delete by its batchId), preview exactly what a permanent deletion removes, delete items permanently, or empty Trash as an administrator. Deleting items permanently needs delete access to each of them. Permanent deletion cannot be undone and erases the deleted records' values from history. Field deletion removes invalid saved-view filters, columns, sort and grouping; its preview and result list affected views and widgets. Restoring the field does not recreate those settings. A later field or view restore reports removed view settings in droppedViewReferences.
manage_webhooks: One tool with an `action` switch: list, get, create, update, delete, plus the delivery log (action list_deliveries, scoped to one webhook's current url when you pass its `id`) and re-delivery (action resend_delivery). Reads need API & Webhooks read access All; create and resend_delivery need Create, update needs Edit and delete needs Delete on API & Webhooks.
manage_widgets: List or read widgets; create, update or delete chart and activity configurations. Charts use measure and displayOptions; timelines use activityQuery and showFilters. Both require expectedRevision and idempotencyKey for writes, plus expectedVersion for updates. Supplied measure, activityQuery or displayOptions replaces that complete value. Timeline scopes and typed filters use stable record/type references, with inclusion, exclusion, account and conversation filters. Shared templates enforce each reader’s data access. Writes accept an optional layout `{x, y, w, h}` on the 12-column grid that is saved in the same call; without it a new widget takes the first free spot and an updated one stays put, and overlapping positions are refused. list returns each widget’s current layout. viewId places a widget on a dashboard view (a saved view of manage_data_views surface dashboard); without it a new widget goes to the caller’s current dashboard view. Delete moves the widget configuration to Trash, never its source records.
manage_wiki_pages: List, search, read, create, update, reorder (move before or after another page) or delete (move to Trash) Knowledge Base pages, each a knowledge page, a procedure with a when-to-use trigger, or the one Operating Guide. Updates and deletes require the latest updatedAt value; create can atomically require an empty Knowledge Base.
move_email_thread: Move an email conversation into another mailbox folder at the provider.
mutate_crm_record: Create, update, delete, link or unlink through one validated operation. Supply expectedRevision and an idempotencyKey; updates and deletions also require the current record version. Use typed field-assignment arrays; `{ fieldId, append }` adds markdown after a blank line to a Formatted text or Text field, and an update that only appends never conflicts with a newer record version. Omitted inputs stay unchanged; null clears an optional input. Calculated fields are read-only. Preview a delete first and pass expectedImpactHash. Pending results carry an operation ID. Delete moves records, their sub-list rows and cascading records to Trash for 30 days and returns a trashBatchId for restoring them; permanent: true deletes them permanently right away. Full Formatted text replacement requires `{kind: "richText", documentJson: "<ProseMirror document JSON string>"}`; Markdown is returned on read but is not a full-replacement input. On a version conflict, read again and retry with the current expectedVersion; the MCP error includes readable current versions.
preview_crm_deletion: Inspect permitted deletion effects, including cascading records, links and dependent calculations. A restricted count is null, never zero. Pass the returned impactHash as expectedImpactHash when applying the approved deletion.
query_crm_measure: Count or aggregate once per source record at an explicit grain. Specify a source query, aggregation, optional valueFieldId and optional relationship/field grouping. Full attribution to several groups can make grouped totals exceed the distinct overall total. Use line items as the source for service quantities and contributions. Equal amounts on different records both count.
query_crm_records: Filter, sort and paginate records of one configured type in PostgreSQL. Read its schema first. Results distinguish values, missing inputs, restricted calculations and errors; decimals are strings. Use query_crm_measure for totals across all matches. A filter names fieldId and operator. Single-value operators use value with one typed scalar; in, notIn, all and between use values with typed scalars and value: null. Multiple choice filters use one `{kind: "select", value: optionId}` scalar per option, not selectList. Invalid-filter errors name the index and field. fields accepts live field IDs from the current record model; an unknown or unpublished ID is named in the error.
read_crm_operation: Read a durable operation by operationId until it completes, fails or is cancelled. Poll with backoff. While staging runs, previous complete data remains readable and workspace CRM writes are paused. A pending response does not mean publication succeeded. Pending and staging status includes retryAfterMs; wait at least that long before polling again.
read_crm_record: Read one record by typeId and recordId, including typed values, formatted text, relationship summaries and current record/configuration versions. Identities appear on lists with a Channels field; identifiers can match several accessible records.
read_trash: List deleted items in Trash, newest first, with who deleted them, when, and the days left before they are deleted permanently. Filter by kind, list and name. Only items you could see and delete are listed; administrators see everything except other members' saved views and widgets, which stay personal. With action read and a record's typeId and recordId, open one deleted record read only as the Trash preview shows it: its values and related records as they were when it was deleted, its list's fields and its Trash item.
request_support: Send a support request to the Customermates team (subject plus description). The team replies by email. Returns only that the request was accepted for delivery.
resolve_record_identifiers: Resolve up to 1,000 exact email, phone or supported profile identifiers through the indexed channel registry. Each input returns every accessible linked record with its type label and current version, plus the workspace schemaRevision, so matches feed updateMany directly. Optional typeIds limit the lists. Empty records arrays mean no accessible match; deduplicate records matched through several identifiers and clarify ambiguity before changing a record.
resume_crm_operation: Resume an owned pending operation after its worker lease expires. The worker reuses staged progress and rechecks publication preconditions; repeating a resume does not duplicate record changes.
save_message_draft: Prepare a message for review: the draft shows up in the inbox and the user sends it. With `threadId` it drafts a reply; with `connectedAccountId` plus `recipients` it prepares a brand-new conversation that exists only as a draft. Returns the message id and opaque revision token; saving again updates the thread's one draft. The signature is appended when the draft is sent, so never write a sign-off into the body.
search: Read-only search across Knowledge Base content, the text of files attached to readable records, accessible CRM records, and product docs. Knowledge Base and file results match the query's words in full text and, when you have AI credits, also by meaning and across languages; pages containing a queried code or identifier come first. Knowledge Base results return a stable `wiki:<uuid>` id and file results a `file:<uuid>` id with the record they belong to, each with a highlighted `snippet`, the matched `section`, and its `offset` for `fetch`; record ids use `record:<typeId>:<recordId>`. When a misspelled word matches no Knowledge Base page or file, it is corrected from their own words and `didYouMean` returns the corrected query the results come from. Compatible with ChatGPT company knowledge and deep research; interactive agents should prefer search_crm_records or search_docs for records and docs. Pass each result id unchanged to fetch. Links into the app are full URLs on this instance (its configured `BASE_URL`) and open the reader's own workspace.
search_crm_records: Search accessible configured types, including customer-created types. includeEmbedded also searches embedded records such as line items. Results include both typeId and recordId. For another page, pass nextCursor with the same searchTerm, typeIds and includeEmbedded. Resolve ambiguous matches before writing.
search_docs: Search over the docs; defaults to the product guides (source=docs); pass source=api or all to include the REST API reference. Matches the query's words in full text and, when you have AI credits, also by meaning. Returns up to 5 pages, each with slug, source, title, url, its best-matching section and anchor, and a snippet, plus the total. Links into the app are full URLs on this instance (its configured `BASE_URL`) and open the reader's own workspace.
send_chat_message: Delivers immediately. With threadId replies in an existing chat; with connectedAccountId plus attendeeIdentifiers starts a new one (optional chatName names a group). To send a saved draft, pass both draftMessageId and draftRevision. New LinkedIn chats default to Classic; set linkedinProduct to sales_navigator or recruiter to send an InMail (needs inmailSubject), or inmail:true to InMail someone outside your network on Classic.
send_email: Delivers immediately. Send or reply from a connected email account; sending a saved draft requires both draftMessageId and draftRevision. The account's enabled signature is appended automatically, so never write a sign-off into the body.
update_messaging_thread: Set the thread state: unread, open, closed, or spam.
update_my_profile: Changes your own name, country, avatar, theme, display language and formatting locale.
